THE COMPLETE DOCTOR ACADEMYMRCPsych Paper B · Domain 13 Research Methods, Statistics and Critical Review

Aim and objectives

Aim. To prepare candidates to calculate and interpret measures of diagnostic accuracy for MRCPsych Paper B.

At the end of this chapter, you should be able to:

  1. Calculate sensitivity and specificity from a 2 x 2 table.
  2. Calculate positive and negative likelihood ratios, LR+ = sensitivity / (1 - specificity) and LR- = (1 - sensitivity) / specificity.
  3. Calculate positive and negative predictive values and show how they change at a different prevalence.
  4. Convert pre-test probability to odds, apply a likelihood ratio and convert back to post-test probability, checking with a Fagan nomogram.
  5. Interpret an ROC curve, where an area under the curve of 0.5 means chance and 1.0 means perfect discrimination.
  6. Answer the chapter's 84 exam-style questions, scoring at least 80%, by the end of this chapter.
